## Why This Is Asked
Tests real-world RN streaming with WebRTC, multi-sensor coordination, and performance under backpressure.

## Key Concepts
- WebRTC integration in React Native
- Camera capture pipelines and encoders
- Backpressure, frame pacing, queue management
- Resource constraints on mobile devices and cross-platform differences

## Code Example
```javascript
function createBackpressureQueue(limit){
  const q = [];
  return {
    enqueue(f){ if (q.length < limit){ q.push(f); return true } return false; },
    dequeue(){ return q.shift(); },
    size(){ return q.length; }
  }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test backpressure behavior under network jitter?
- What are the trade-offs between software vs. native encoding paths in RN?

Why This Is Asked

Key Concepts

- JSI/TurboModule bridging and dedicated native threads

- Sampling controls: minDistance, minTime
- Privacy and permissions handling differences by platform
- UI integration for sparkline and map marker

// Sketch: useLocationStream hook
import { useLocationStream } from 'react-native-location';
function SpeedChart() {

  return null; // rendering handled by parent

Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle background location updates and user-initiated stop?
- What security considerations and data minimization would you implement?
